program: v22 temporal-memory screen (14 Aug 2026): on one-step-ahead Mackey-Glass prediction, does a fixed random reservoir earn its recurrence over the no-memory ridge baseline, the additive tap-delay line, and hand-written programmatic primitives?

registration_notes.N96.1: Question registered before measurement: the reservoir family lost on the DSL next-token task (M134 r128 ppl 29.72 / r512 27.54 vs count w4 3.32 / transformer 2.80) - that loss is a REGISTERED PRIOR on the DSL axis only. This screen re-tests on the chaotic-series axis where the prior does not bind (epistemic rule 2), and reproduces the M134 r128 reservoir on the DSL as a t1 anchor for the reused machinery.
registration_notes.N96.2: Arms: no_memory (ridge on x(t)), tap_delay k in {2,4,8} (ridge on concatenated past), programmatic (extrapolator x_hat=2x(t)-x(t-1), EWMA alpha=0.3, and ridge on hand-written primitive features [x, delta, mean4, std4]; best of three), reservoir (tanh, W_rec scaled to rho < 1, warmup 200 discarded, ridge readout; seeds {21,22,23} x units {64,256,1024} x rho {0.5,0.9,0.99}), mlp (tiny Adam-trained MLP, the trained measuring stick).
registration_notes.N96.3: Echo-state property: the measured spectral radius of the scaled W_rec is recorded per run and must be < 1 before any reservoir readout is trusted.
registration_notes.N96.4: Metric: NRMSFE = RMSE / std(test target). Reported per arm; the gate uses the best reservoir per seed across (units, rho).
registration_notes.N96.5: Kill switch (registered): the reservoir's best NRMSFE must beat the best NON-recurrent arm (no_memory / tap_delay / programmatic) by >= 5% relative on >= 2 of 3 seeds, AND the t1 anchor must reproduce M134 r128 ppl within 0.01. Otherwise M147 closes as a scoped negative on this axis.
registration_notes.N96.6: Mackey-Glass parameters fixed: tau=17, beta=0.2, gamma=0.1, n=10, RK4 dt=0.1, sample every 10 steps (1.0 time-unit resolution, the canonical ESN benchmark), x0=1.2 + seeded jitter, discard 10000 RK4 steps, train 5000, test 1000, seed 7.
registration_notes.N96.7: Smoke runs declare _smoke_note and MUST refuse the sealed output directory; smoke skips the mlp arm and all gates.
registration_notes.N96.8: Dated snapshot: all seeds, radii, ladders recorded for byte-repeat.

gate.registered: reservoir best NRMSFE <= (1 - 0.05) x best non-recurrent arm on >= 2 of 3 seeds, and t1 anchor within 0.01 ppl; else the recurrence does not earn its keep on this axis (scoped negative).
gate.consequence_fired: the reservoir's recurrence does not earn its keep on the chaotic-series axis; M147 closes as a scoped negative and the temporal path falls back to additive / programmatic memory (the M134 DSL prior and this axis now agree).
gate.consequence_passed: the reservoir beats all non-recurrent arms by the registered margin on the chaotic-series axis; feedback earns its keep and the reservoir stays a first-class arm of the temporal branch.
